description_en: Obtain the outbound call job progress by instance ID and job ID.
description_zh: 根据实例ID、任务ID获取外呼任务进展
name: GetAiOutboundTaskProgress

parameters.help_en: The Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service (AICCS) instance ID. You can obtain it in the Instance Management section of the left-side navigation pane in the Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service console (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/overview)
parameters.help_zh: AICCS实例ID。 您可以在智能联络中心控制台 (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/overview)左侧导航栏的实例管理中获取
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
Job ID.

You can invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/312260.html API and check the Data field in the response, or invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2718026.html API and check the TaskId field in the response
parameters.help_zh:
任务ID。

可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/312260.html接口，查看返回参数中的**Data**，或者调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2718026.html接口，查看返回参数中的**TaskId**
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.help_en:
Job batch.

If empty, queries all data under the job
parameters.help_zh:
任务批次。

为空则查询任务下所有数据
parameters.name: batch_version
